maddeler.e:
نطمئن (form IVq)
# نَطْمَئِنُّ (naṭmaʔinnu) /natˤ.ma.ʔin.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
# نَطْمَئِنَّ (naṭmaʔinna) /natˤ.ma.ʔin.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
# نَطْمَئِنِّ (naṭmaʔinni) /natˤ.ma.ʔin.ni/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
